title: Closeness of the coordinate junta approximation
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and suppose that $\varepsilon>0$ and the total influence of $f$ is positive. The function obtained by thresholding the coordinate projection of $f$ onto its Friedgut coordinate set at parameter $\varepsilon$ has relative Hamming distance at most $\varepsilon$ from $f$.
hypotheses_covered: The total influence of $f$ is positive
